focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞：半導體設備、載板、記憶體、伺服器需求與工廠自動化
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asia: semiconductor equipment, substrates, memory, server demand and factory automation

throughline.zh: 台灣與馬來西亞最新貿易統計均顯示電子相關需求成長，台灣展會與設備公告則提供量測、載板及自動化的具體技術進度。
throughline.en: Taiwanese and Malaysian trade statistics show electronics-related growth, while Taiwan's exhibition and equipment releases provide concrete progress on metrology, substrates and automation.

text.zh: 台灣 9 月外銷訂單 1,142.1 億美元，年增 62.4%；經濟部提醒部分訂單在海外生產。
text.en: Taiwan's September export orders hit US$114.21 billion, up 62.4%; some orders are produced overseas.

text.zh: 美光桃園工會規劃 10 月 22 日單日罷工，台中仍協商；目前沒有已確認產量損失。
text.en: Micron's Taoyuan union plans a one-day October 22 strike; Taichung talks continue and output effects are unconfirmed.

text.zh: 工研院將載板溫測系統整合群翊設備，宣稱可減少 20% 材料廢品；缺少獨立驗證數據。
text.en: ITRI says its substrate thermal system is integrated into equipment and cuts material waste 20%; independent validation is missing.

text.zh: 經濟部招商論壇公布 27 案約 6,660 億元投資規劃，13 家簽署意向書，尚未等同實際到資。
text.en: Taiwan's investment forum reported about NT$666 billion in 27 proposals and 13 signed LOIs, not realized investment.

text.zh: 馬來西亞 9 月出口年增 54.5%，電機電子產品為主因；國內出口與再出口應分開比較。
text.en: Malaysia's September exports rose 54.5%, driven largely by E&E goods; domestic exports and re-exports differ.

title.zh: 台灣 9 月外銷訂單達 1,142.1 億美元，年增 62.4%
title.en: Taiwan September export orders reach US$114.21 billion, up 62.4%

summary.zh: 經濟部 10 月 20 日公布，2026 年 9 月外銷訂單達 1,142.1 億美元，較去年同期增加 62.4%；前九月累計達 8,192 億美元，年增 56%。資訊通信與電子產品為主要成長項目，但外銷訂單可由海外工廠生產，不能直接視為台灣境內出口或產值。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs reported on October 20 that September 2026 export orders reached US$114.21 billion, up 62.4% year on year, while January–September orders totaled US$819.2 billion, up 56%. Information and communications products and electronics were principal drivers, but export orders include goods manufactured overseas and do not equal Taiwan's physical exports.

text.zh: 經濟部統計與中央社報導指出，9 月資訊通信產品訂單年增 87.3%，電子產品訂單年增 71.0%，對應伺服器、網通設備與半導體供應鏈。光學器材訂單年減 5.6%，部分檢測與量測設備訂單成長仍不足以抵銷其他品項減幅。
text.en: MOEA data reported by CNA show year-on-year order growth of 87.3% for information and communications products and 71.0% for electronics, categories that include server, networking and semiconductor supply chains. Optical equipment orders fell 5.6%, despite growth in certain inspection and metrology orders.

text.zh: 9 月美元計價訂單較 8 月增加 112.5 億美元，未經季節調整月增 10.9%，經季節調整後月增 1.1%。第三季訂單 3,151 億美元，季增 15.8%、年增 65.0%；前九月累計的年增率為 56.0%，不同期間不得直接混用。
text.en: September orders rose US$11.25 billion from August, up 10.9% before seasonal adjustment and 1.1% after adjustment. Third-quarter orders were US$315.1 billion, rising 15.8% quarter on quarter and 65.0% year on year; the nine-month growth rate was 56.0%, a distinct comparison period.

text.zh: 外銷訂單不直接揭露每家廠商的實際出貨、台灣生產比例或供應商分配，也無法從總額拆解個別晶圓廠、封裝廠或電源設備業者的訂單。
text.en: Aggregate export orders do not disclose individual supplier shipments, Taiwan-based production shares or allocations among wafer fabs, packaging providers and power-equipment makers.

title.zh: 美光桃園工會宣布 10 月 22 日單日罷工，台中協商仍在進行
title.en: Micron's Taoyuan union schedules October 22 one-day strike as Taichung talks continue

summary.zh: 路透社 10 月 20 日報導，美光桃園工會宣布擬於 10 月 22 日進行單日警告性罷工，日期與美光台中工會的勞資調解同日。美光在台灣製造 DRAM 與 HBM，惟截至報導時尚無實際停工、產量損失或交期受影響的確認資料。
summary.en: Reuters reported on October 20 that Micron's Taoyuan union scheduled a one-day warning strike for October 22, the same day as a mediation session involving the Taichung union. Micron manufactures DRAM and HBM in Taiwan, but no actual stoppage, production loss or delivery disruption had been confirmed at publication.

label.zh: 記憶體供應鏈與廠區區別
label.en: Memory supply chain and site distinction

text.zh: 桃園與台中工會是不同團體。路透社引述桃園工會說明，本次行動要求本年度獎金與可預期的分紅機制；台中工會截至 10 月 20 日尚未進行罷工投票。台灣廠區涉及一般 DRAM 與供 AI 伺服器使用的高頻寬記憶體，實際受影響產品須以公司和工會後續公告為準。
text.en: The Taoyuan and Taichung unions are separate organizations. Reuters cited Taoyuan representatives seeking a satisfactory annual bonus and a predictable profit-sharing mechanism, while the Taichung union had not held a strike vote as of October 20. Taiwanese operations include DRAM and HBM for AI servers, but product-specific exposure depends on subsequent disclosures.

text.zh: 報導引述美光表示尊重員工合法權利，並願繼續與兩地工會本於誠信協商。桃園工會先前已取得罷工授權，本次新進展是宣布具體預定日期；因此不能把 10 月 20 日公告描述為罷工已經發生。
text.en: Micron told Reuters it respects employees' legal rights and intends to engage both unions in good faith. The Taoyuan union had already obtained strike authorization; the new October 20 development was the announcement of a specific planned date, not a strike already under way.

text.zh: 工會原始聲明目前未取得可直接核對的公開網址，時間表依路透社引述；實際參與人數、受影響產線、停工時數與產能損失都尚未確定。
text.en: A publicly accessible original union statement was not independently retrieved, so the schedule rests on Reuters' direct reporting. Participation, affected lines, actual stoppage hours and output effects remain unconfirmed.

ceoView.en: Test, metrology and process-power suppliers would distinguish operational exposure at Taoyuan and Taichung, including equipment support and new-product qualification. The strike has not yet occurred and no verified production loss supports a procurement inference.

title.zh: 工研院發布高階載板即時溫測技術，已整合群翊熱製程設備
title.en: ITRI unveils real-time substrate thermal metrology integrated into Group Up's equipment

summary.zh: 工研院 10 月 20 日在台北 TPCA Show 公布 AI 動態即時溫測校準系統，稱已成為群翊工業熱製程設備的整機標配，並宣稱可降低 20% 材料廢品。該項性能由工研院公告，尚缺獨立的客戶產線驗證樣本與良率統計。
summary.en: ITRI presented an AI-based real-time thermal calibration system at Taipei's TPCA Show on October 20 and said it had become standard equipment in Group Up Industrial's thermal-processing systems, claiming a 20% reduction in material waste. The performance claim comes from ITRI; independent customer-line datasets and yield results were not disclosed.

text.zh: 高階 ABF 載板的熱固化均勻性會影響鼓包、分層與電性失效。工研院表示，以多模態紅外線和時序校正，修正高反射複合材料過去超過 5°C 的熱像量測偏差；另與川碩科技合作將微粒子監控整合於濕製程設備。
text.en: Thermal-curing uniformity in high-end ABF substrates affects blistering, delamination and electrical failures. ITRI described using multimodal infrared sensing and temporal calibration to address image-based temperature errors previously exceeding 5°C on reflective composites; it also integrated particle monitoring into wet-process equipment with a separate equipment partner.

text.zh: 工研院稱目標可將出站不良率壓至 1% 以下，廣域空壓洩漏感測則具 5 至 10 公尺定位能力，約可降低空壓能耗 15%。這些指標涉及不同系統與量測對象，20% 廢品減量不能直接代表所有載板產品的良率改善。
text.en: ITRI stated an outgoing-defect rate below 1% as a potential process outcome; a separate air-leak detection system covers 5–10 meters and claims roughly 15% compressed-air energy savings. These figures refer to distinct systems and measurement targets, so the 20% waste claim is not a general yield improvement rate for every substrate.

text.zh: 未列明第三方測試方法、材料廢品減少的比較基期、安裝台數，以及群翊設備在客戶量產線的覆蓋率。
text.en: Independent test protocols, the waste-reduction baseline, installed-unit counts and customer production-line penetration were not disclosed.

title.zh: 經濟部招商論壇簽 13 家跨國企業意向書，27 案規劃額約 6,660 億元
title.en: Taiwan investment forum signs 13 foreign-company LOIs; 27 proposals total about NT$666 billion

summary.zh: 經濟部 10 月 20 日在台北舉辦全球招商論壇，公布掌握 27 家業者約新台幣 6,660 億元投資規劃，其中 13 家簽署投資意向書。範圍包括半導體與非科技服務業，所列金額屬意向與規劃，尚未等同核准、到資或建廠支出。
summary.en: Taiwan's MOEA said at its October 20 investment forum in Taipei that 27 prospective investors represented about NT$666 billion in proposals, and 13 companies signed letters of intent. The total spans semiconductors and non-technology services, so it represents plans and expressions of intent rather than approved, funded or completed factory spending.

text.zh: 經濟部指明 13 家意向書業者規劃的未來投資約 621 億元，為全部 27 家約 6,660 億元規劃的子集合。公告點名巴斯夫擴建桃園觀音廠以服務先進製程化學材料、啟諾迪規劃擴產並預計增加約 200 個職缺、佳能半導體設備規劃台灣訓練中心，以及科林研發擴展在台研發活動；各案執行時間和資本支出須另行核對。
text.en: MOEA said the 13 LOI signatories proposed about NT$62.1 billion of future investment, a subset of the roughly NT$666 billion across 27 prospective investors. Named participants included BASF expanding its Guanyin chemicals facility for advanced processes, Qnity planning capacity and about 200 additional jobs, Canon Semiconductor Equipment planning a Taiwan training center, and Lam Research expanding local R&D. Execution dates and expenditure schedules require project-level confirmation.

text.zh: 經濟部稱 2026 年 1 至 9 月外人來台投資額 192.3 億美元，與未來投資意向的定義不同，不能直接相加。13 家意向書約 621 億元仍屬規劃，須確認政府審批、正式合約與分期支出，且高科技以外也有零售服務業。
text.en: MOEA separately cited US$19.23 billion in inward investment for January–September 2026, a different measure that cannot be added to forward-looking LOIs. The NT$62.1 billion represented by the 13 signatories remains planned investment subject to approvals, binding contracts and spending schedules; the portfolio also includes non-technology services.

text.zh: 尚未公布 27 案逐案產業分類、實際廠址、可比投資期間，以及 13 家意向書轉成正式投資的進度。
text.en: Project-level industries, sites, comparable investment periods and conversion of the 13 LOIs into binding investment were not fully disclosed.

title.zh: TPCA Show 開幕稿列逾 680 品牌、1,840 攤位，新增先進封裝主題區
title.en: TPCA Show opening reports over 680 brands, 1,840 booths and an advanced-packaging zone

summary.zh: 台灣電路板協會 10 月 20 日宣布 TPCA Show 2026 在台北南港展覽館一館開幕，開幕新聞稿列超過 680 個國際品牌與 1,840 個攤位，展至 22 日。八大展區涵蓋 PCB、載板、材料、製程與檢測設備，並設置先進封裝專區；觀眾數屬展前預估，尚非實際到場數。
summary.en: The Taiwan Printed Circuit Association said TPCA Show 2026 opened at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1 on October 20, with more than 680 brands and 1,840 booths reported in the opening release; the exhibition runs through October 22. Eight zones span PCBs, substrates, materials, process and inspection equipment, plus a dedicated advanced-packaging area, while visitor numbers remain forecasts.

text.zh: 主辦方公布的展區包括高階載板、PCB 原物料及化學品、乾濕製程設備、工廠自動化、檢測、構裝、SMT 與綠色技術。先進封裝主題區反映展示內容配置，不能從參展數量推論新增設備訂單。
text.en: Organizer-listed zones cover advanced substrates, PCB materials and chemicals, dry and wet processing, automation, inspection, electronic packaging, SMT and green technology. The packaging zone is a program feature and cannot establish incremental equipment orders by itself.

text.zh: TPCA 表示同期 IMPACT 技術研討會自 10 月 19 日開始，約有 350 篇發表、報名人數超過 1,500。較早展前宣傳曾列 670 品牌與 1,830 攤位，10 月 20 日開幕稿更新為逾 680 品牌與 1,840 攤位，採較新的主辦方公告並保留口徑差異。
text.en: The organizer states that the concurrent IMPACT conference began October 19 with about 350 technical presentations and more than 1,500 registrations. Earlier promotional material listed 670 brands and 1,830 booths; the October 20 opening release updated these to over 680 brands and 1,840 booths.

text.zh: 實際專業觀眾人數、展中設備簽單、量產客戶認證與展出產品成交額仍待展後或公司公告。
text.en: Actual visitors, equipment sales, production qualifications and transaction values await post-show or company disclosures.

location.en: Taipei, Taiwan, Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1, Floors 1 and 4; exhibition venue.

title.zh: 馬來西亞 9 月出口達 2,151 億令吉，年增 54.5%，電子電機產品為主因
title.en: Malaysia's September exports rise 54.5% to RM215.1 billion, led by electronics

summary.zh: 馬來西亞統計局 10 月 19 日公布，2026 年 9 月出口達 2,151 億令吉，年增 54.5%，進口達 1,814 億令吉，年增 52.7%。官方指出電機電子產品是主要驅動因素，但整體貿易額包含不同商品和再出口，不能視為半導體產量。
summary.en: Malaysia's Department of Statistics reported on October 19 that September exports reached RM215.1 billion, up 54.5% year on year, while imports reached RM181.4 billion, up 52.7%. Officials identified electrical and electronic products as a major driver, but the trade figures include other goods and re-exports and cannot be treated as semiconductor output.

text.zh: 統計局公布 9 月貿易總額 3,965 億令吉，年增 53.7%。出口中的國內出口額為 1,620 億令吉，佔 75.3%，再出口額 531 億令吉，佔 24.7%；馬來西亞電機電子產業包含半導體封測與設備相關商品，仍應與零件的製造地和轉運活動分開解讀。
text.en: DOSM recorded RM396.5 billion in total trade, up 53.7% year on year. Domestic exports reached RM162.0 billion, or 75.3% of exports, while re-exports reached RM53.1 billion, or 24.7%. Malaysia's E&E trade includes semiconductor assembly/test-related goods, but production and re-export channels must remain distinct.

text.zh: 9 月進口年增 52.7%，其中中間財進口增 69.6%，資本財進口增 20.9%。這是進口用途分類的年增率，無法單獨推論新半導體設備安裝或產能利用率。
text.en: Imports rose 52.7% year on year; intermediate-goods imports rose 69.6% and capital-goods imports 20.9%. These are end-use-category import growth rates, not direct measures of installed semiconductor equipment or utilization.

text.zh: 公告未按廠商揭露封測、記憶體或資料中心零件的進出口分布，與台灣供應商之間的直接交易額需另查雙邊細項。
text.en: The release does not identify company-specific packaging, memory or data-center-component flows; direct trade with Taiwanese suppliers requires bilateral product data.

title.zh: TAITRONICS 產發署主題館展示 65 項成果，公布臺荷智慧港口合作意向
title.en: Taiwan's TAITRONICS industry pavilion displays 65 results and announces Dutch-port cooperation

summary.zh: 經濟部產業發展署 10 月 20 日在台北 TAITRONICS & AIoT Taiwan 2026 展示 65 項技術成果，並稱相關輔導帶動產值超過 342 億元。安恩嘉與荷蘭 CERTUS Automation 簽署港口 AI 視覺合作備忘錄；產發署指出該技術已於鹿特丹港試用且取得訂單，但展館總產值的個案歸屬未公開。
summary.en: Taiwan's Industrial Development Administration showcased 65 technology results at TAITRONICS & AIoT Taiwan on October 20, claiming associated program output exceeding NT$34.2 billion. Taiwanese firm An-En-Jia signed an AI-vision cooperation memorandum with Dutch company CERTUS Automation; the agency reported a Rotterdam port trial and a formal order, without a breakdown of output across exhibitors.

text.zh: 主題館分 AI 晶片、次世代通訊、產業 AI 化、智慧顯示及新創五區，與嵌入式系統、智慧電源及工廠應用相關。產發署表示近三年在電子資訊產業透過政策計畫投入約 70 億元；此為政策投入敘述，與產值的統計口徑不同。
text.en: The five zones cover AI chips, next-generation communications, industrial AI, smart displays and startups, linking embedded systems, power electronics and factories. The agency separately reported around NT$7 billion in policy support over three years, a different measure from supported output.

text.zh: 產發署指出，安恩嘉與荷蘭 CERTUS Automation 合作的技術在 2025 年於高雄港完成商業驗證，2026 年 6 月在鹿特丹港試用並取得正式訂單，預計 2027 年 1 月全面導入。此為產發署轉述的業者進度；正式訂單金額、交付設備數量與驗收條件未公布。
text.en: According to IDA, An-En-Jia's system completed commercial validation at Kaohsiung Port in 2025, underwent a Rotterdam Port trial in June 2026, and secured a formal order. Full rollout is planned for January 2027, but order value, delivered unit count and acceptance criteria were not disclosed.

text.zh: 產發署未分年列示 342 億元產值的公司、產品與統計口徑；鹿特丹港正式訂單的契約規模、裝機數量和實際使用成效也未公開。
text.en: IDA did not disaggregate the NT$34.2 billion in attributed output by company, product or reporting period; the Rotterdam contract value, installed units and actual field outcomes remain unpublished.

title.zh: 經濟部在高雄台氯林園廠展示六類智慧工安監測技術
title.en: MOEA demonstrates six smart industrial-safety technologies at Kaohsiung's Linyuan plant

summary.zh: 經濟部產業發展署 10 月 20 日在高雄台氯林園廠舉辦工安技術示範，公布六類應用，涵蓋人員定位、巡檢、VOCs 分析、影像辨識、管線監測及工廠管理平台。這是現場示範與政策輔導成果，官方尚未列出工廠故障率、停機率或事故率的前後實測比較。
summary.en: Taiwan's Industrial Development Administration demonstrated six smart industrial-safety applications at Taiwan VCM's Linyuan factory in Kaohsiung on October 20, covering worker location, inspection, VOC analysis, machine vision, pipeline monitoring and factory management. The event documented a pilot implementation, but the agency did not report verified before-and-after fault, downtime or incident rates.

text.zh: 六類應用包含人員異常辨識及定位、智慧巡檢、揮發性有機物檢測分析、人車環境影像辨識、設備管線監測，以及廠務營運管理。對應的是感測器、工業控制、監測軟體與現場設備維護等環節，與晶圓設備的驗證標準應分開理解。
text.en: Six categories include anomalous-worker detection and location, automated inspections, volatile-organic-compound analysis, people/vehicle imaging, equipment and pipeline monitoring, and factory operations management. They touch sensors, industrial controls and maintenance software, whose qualification criteria differ from semiconductor-production tools.

text.zh: 產發署指出自 2024 年推動林園園區的智慧工安計畫，台氯廠參與並獲選示範案例。10 月 20 日的新進展是現場展示技術應用；過往計畫成立時間不能當成本次全新部署日期。
text.en: IDA says its smart-safety program began in 2024, with Taiwan VCM participating as a demonstration site. The new October 20 development was the on-site showcase, not the initial installation of all systems.

text.zh: 尚未公布六項技術的設備數量、廠區覆蓋率、同口徑事故改善數據或跨廠擴充預算。
text.en: Equipment counts, plant coverage, comparable safety outcomes and rollout budgets across other factories remain undisclosed.

question.zh: 台灣外銷訂單與實際出口有哪些不同？
question.en: How do Taiwan's export orders differ from actual exports?

text.zh: 經濟部的外銷訂單統計涵蓋可能在海外生產的訂單；檢查資訊通信、電子產品與境內產值時，應保持指標和期間一致。
text.en: MOEA export orders can be fulfilled by overseas factories. Compare ICT and electronics orders with Taiwan production only when definitions and periods align.

question.zh: 10 月 22 日美光勞資行動是否已影響 HBM？
question.en: Has Micron's planned October 22 action affected HBM output?

text.zh: 截至 10 月 20 日報導，桃園工會僅宣布預定日期，台中工會仍協商，且未取得實際停工與 HBM 產量資料。
text.en: As of the October 20 report, Taoyuan had announced a planned date and Taichung was still negotiating; no stoppage or HBM production figures were confirmed.

question.zh: 工研院宣稱的減廢成效與量產良率如何區分？
question.en: How does ITRI's waste-reduction claim relate to production yield?

text.zh: 20% 材料減廢、1% 以下出站不良率與 15% 空壓節能各有不同分母及設備對象，目前沒有公開跨客戶產線的同口徑實測比較。
text.en: The 20% waste, sub-1% outgoing-defect and 15% compressed-air savings figures concern different systems and denominators; cross-customer comparable data remain unpublished.

text.zh: 台灣外銷訂單和馬來西亞對外貿易皆屬 2026 年 9 月資料，發布日期分別是 10 月 20 日及 19 日。訂單、海關出口與工廠產量涵蓋範圍不同。
text.en: Taiwan's export-order release and Malaysia's trade release both cover September 2026, published on October 20 and 19 respectively. Orders, customs exports and plant output use different definitions.

verificationNote.zh: 美光桃園工會預定行動的原始公告連結尚未獨立取得，日期與公司回應依路透社採訪。工研院性能數字為發布單位自行聲明；TPCA 開幕稿展商數高於展前宣傳，並採用較新的開幕口徑。
verificationNote.en: The original Taoyuan union announcement was not independently retrieved; the planned date and Micron response rely on Reuters reporting. ITRI performance figures are the institute's own claims. TPCA's opening brand count exceeds its earlier promotional count; the newer opening figures are used.
